analysis.title: Botanical Earth-Tone Landing Page
analysis.notes: A tall landing-page composition pairs a leafy botanical hero with a structured grid of rounded feature cards. Deep greens, muted browns, sage tones, grain, and soft shadows create a warm natural interface with strong tactile depth.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a vertical editorial landing-page hero featuring overlapping botanical leaves with detailed veins, arranged against a split background of deep teal green and muted terracotta brown. Use soft directional lighting, subtle paper grain, gentle shadows, and a refined earthy palette of forest green, sage, clay, and warm cream. Keep generous negative space on the left for headline placement, with the foliage concentrated on the right and lower edge. Contemporary art direction, tactile material detail, polished product-design presentation, no logos, no readable text, no people.
